# game probe summary

Seeds: 0..64; samples every 120 ticks.

Quantiles use linear interpolation. Day checkpoints are exact even when the sampling interval does not divide a day. Idle breach share is cumulative sampled breaches / sampled agents (including tick 0). Performance uses primary-engine tick wall time / exact pre-tick agent count sum; run wall time includes I/O and optional twin validation.
